text:
Mira (Infra): Quick heads-up — Hosted Streaming + Multiplexed Toolcall v1.5 is GA as of today. Rolling to all regions over the next 24h. Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/streaming-v1-5

Emily (Product): Highlights: multiplexed client sessions (single socket -> multiple concurrent requests), function-calling v2 (typed outputs + structured args), streaming checkpoints (resume after network drop). Also introducing per-route soft quotas and burst controls.

Devon (Eng): Migration notes:
- endpoint: POST /v1/streaming_v1_5 (old /v1/stream will be deprecated on 2026-06-15)
- client: update SDKs to >=0.12.3
- example curl:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"nebula-l2","multiplex":true,"tool_calls":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streaming_v1_5
```

Ops Bot: Deploy complete — canary passed (us-west1), global rollout in progress :rocket: (monitor: https://status.redwood.ai)

Luis (Support): Any cost deltas customers should expect?

Mira (Infra): Expected unit token cost ~+4% at default batching for hosted tiers; you can use Console -> Optimize -> Streaming to adjust batching/kv-cache to reduce to parity. Dedicated customers: contact infra for pinned quant/throughput configs.

Sasha (ML): Model note: nebula-l2 and mosaicx-lite-v3 are verified with v1.5. If you rely on exact KV-cache boundary semantics, run your evals — minor seq-edge behavior changed for very short prefixes.

Devon (Eng): Rollout plan: gradual ramp over 24h. Old endpoint will 301 to the new for 30 days, then return 410 on deprecation date. SDK patches inbound today; please upgrade before 2026-06-01 for best behavior.

Emily (Product): Customer comms scheduled: email blast to trial + enterprise tiers at 10:00 PDT. If you want priority outreach for specific customers, DM me now.

Mira (Infra): Troubleshooting: if you hit errors, tag #eng-oncall and include header X-Stream-Debug. We've enabled extra traces for the next 72h. Thanks everyone for the help :heart:

Alex (CEO): Amazing work — congrats team! :clap:
